report:
MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

Focal space occupying lesion in infrapatellar fat pad between patellar tendon an tibial plateau, showing intermediate signal intensity on T1WI and hyperintensity on T2WI, about 4*2*4 cm in size, with slight perifocal edema, R/O nodular fasciitis or tenosynovial gaint cell tumor or fibroma of the tendon sheath/ tenosynovial fibroma.
Subcutaneous infiltration over anterior knee, especially along patellar tendon.
Mild fraying articular cartilage of patella, in favor of grade 2 chondromalacia.
No significant bone marrow edema of distal femur and proximal tibia and patella.
Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration or meniscal vascularity 
Mild joint effusion of left knee

Impression:
1. A infrapatellar mass, R/O nodular fasciitis or tenosynovial gaint cell tumor or fibroma of the tendon sheath/ tenosynovial fibroma.
   Subcutaneous infiltration over anterior knee, especially along patellar tendon.
2. Grade 2 patellar chondromalacia
3. Grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration or meniscal vascularity. 
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and biopsy for further evaluation

MRI of Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS



> Heterogenous signal intensity of patellar cartilage with mild fraying surface, R/O grade 2 patellar chondromalacia.
> Mild fat stranding over infrapatellar fat pad.
> The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> No strong MR evidence of  tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
> Some joint effusion
Impression: 
1. R/O grade 2 patellar chondromalacia.
2.  Mild fat stranding over infrapatellar fat pad, R/O contusion or focal inflammation.

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Hallazgos:
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Fibrilación marginal del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco lateral.
Menisco medial de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de la zona de carga de los compartimentos
femorotibiales.
Úlceras condrales de espesor total con cambios óseos secundarios de distribución difusa de la
articulación patelofemoral.
Moderado derrame articular con sinovitis difusa. Quiste poplíteo polilobulado con sinovitis y
fenómenos de filtración hacia caudal.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales.
Tendón rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
Impresión:
Fibrilación marginal del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco lateral.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 y 3 de los compartimentos femorotibiales.
Condropatía con lesiones grado 3 y 4 de la articulación patelofemoral.
Moderado derrame articular con sinovitis difusa. Quiste poplíteo o sinovitis y fenómenos de
filtración hacia caudal.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales
